Why are families looking at stem‑cell therapy for autism in Mexico?

PlacidWay lists autism‑focused regenerative programs in Tijuana, Monterrey and Mexico City.
Stem‑cell interventions for autism are still investigational and not FDA‑approved.
Published reviews note the studies are small, heterogeneous and have not yet established effectiveness.
